title.tr: Metal basamaklı merdiven, ahşap küpeşte ve halat korkuluk
title.en: Metal-tread stairs with timber handrail and rope balustrade

alt.tr: Metal basamaklı merdivende ahşap küpeşte ve ince halatlı korkuluk; yanda taş duvar ve zeytin ağacı
alt.en: Metal-tread staircase with a timber handrail and thin-rope balustrade, a stone wall and an olive tree beside it

caption.tr: Küpeşte ahşap, dolgusu ince halatlardan. Merdiven taş duvarın önünde yükseliyor.
caption.en: The handrail is timber and the infill is thin rope. The stairs rise in front of a stone wall.
